findings.issue: הָיְתָה is qal perfect 3fs whose subject is רוּחַ (אַחֶרֶת agrees fs); that spirit was with him. «fue espíritu otro con él» predicates «espíritu otro» of Calev.
בָּא is qal perfect 3ms and שָׁמָּה resumes the land as the place he came to. «que vino» makes הָאָרֶץ the one who came.

notes: Servant, name, causal עֵקֶב, piel מלא + אַחֲרַי, hiphil «lo traeré», and זֶרַע + hiphil 3fs «la heredará» stay within the tokens.
